headline: Brent crude surges higher
summary: Crude prices rose more than one dollar a barrel at the start of the trading week after a US strike on an Iranian outpost on Larak Island. Iran responded with a counter-attack.
why: Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz affect a large share of seaborne oil supply.
